run: prepare.py --size 1280x820 --evidence vocab, then the same launcher again without reseeding

pronunciation.phonetic_source: experiments/nsh-reader/native-workbench/pronunciation.ts (sample wordbook resource, not a Core or wire field)
pronunciation.voice: host VocabHost.pronounce(text, accent, rate) -> macOS /usr/bin/say; prefers installed Samantha (en_US) / Daniel (en_GB) including localized names, falls back to another voice of the locale, then the system default
pronunciation.rate: rate=normal uses 165 WPM, rate=slow uses 120 WPM; the slow preference applies to manual, example and automatic readings
pronunciation.preferences: 自动朗读/慢速 live in the app's own storage (vocab.autoRead / vocab.slowRead), not in Core or the wire; the first evidence run resets them to the defaults and turns them on, and the restart run keeps them (visible in restart-decks.png)
pronunciation.verified: with 自动朗读 and 慢速 on, entering the deck read the first card on its own: 正在朗读「abandon」 · 美音（Samantha）; the UK switch read it again as 正在朗读「abandon」 · 英音（Daniel）
pronunciation.not_verified: audibility, volume, latency and the slower pace are not machine-recorded; the artifact can only show that the host called say, which voice it selected and that automatic reading started

restart.state: same Core, app relaunched without reseeding; CET-4 shows 0 due / 0 new, the queue is empty, and the reading preferences stored by the first run are still on

not_verified: 听感、音量、朗读延迟与慢速语速没有机器记录；实窗只证明宿主调用了 say、选到哪个语音，以及自动朗读会自己开始
